description: Election Commission - Mr. Kankanige Nimal Wijayasena Perera has Selected as the member of the Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha -
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election matters, which include candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations related to electoral processes.
